Home is where the pudding is.

Buttercup is a banana pudding dessert bar on Deansgate. It started at home, sold more than 50,000 puddings, and now has its first standalone shop inside the Great Northern Warehouse.

The puddings

Three puddings on the counter, including the rotating third flavour, plus the 12 Puds of Christmas seasonal line. No fuss, just pick a cup.

  • Classic Banana PuddingThe signature

    The one Buttercup is known for. Banana pudding layered in a cup, ready to spoon.

  • Tiramisu PuddingOn the counter

    A tiramisu inspired pudding, served by the cup.

  • Honey I'm HomeRotating flavour

    The launch flavour for the rotating third spot. Honey and brown butter.

  • Coffee from AllpressDrinks

    Coffee to go with your pudding, made with Allpress coffee.

  • MatchaDrinks

    Matcha on the drinks list, for something a little different with your cup.

From a home kitchen to Deansgate

Buttercup did not start as a shop. It started at home, grew a queue, and earned its own front door.

The story so far

July 2025
Natasha Black starts Buttercup as a home based project.
Home and residency
More than 50,000 puddings sold, plus a nine month residency inside Deansgate General Store.
31 August 2026
The residency ends, making way for a shop of its own.
26 September 2026
First standalone shop opens at 225 Deansgate, with queues out of the door on opening day.

Founder Natasha Black started Buttercup at home in July 2025. The puddings found their people quickly. From home sales to a nine month residency inside Deansgate General Store, more than 50,000 puddings were sold before Buttercup had a shop to call its own.

When the residency ended on 31 August 2026, the next step was clear. On Saturday 26 September 2026, Buttercup opened its first standalone dessert bar at 225 Deansgate, inside the Great Northern Warehouse. There were queues out of the door on opening day.

Now the counter serves the Classic, the Tiramisu Pudding and a rotating flavour, with build your own cups, Allpress coffee and matcha alongside. Same pudding, now with a home of its own.

Home is where the pudding is.
